additional_info.subject: ID0467951-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001586] No Energy Transactions Issue CRM:03289000008
additional_info.body:
Dear Benjamin,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
After carefully checking the logs of the charger at the timestamp that was given, we see that the connection was lost between the car and the charger at that specific moment. This had to do with a network error.
Now we can’t see any errors in the charger, and the charger looks healthy
We will keep an eye on the charger for the next two days, to see if the problem occurs again. We can deepdive in the issue when there seems to be a live error.
Please provide us with feedback if this answered your question, or if the issue is still occurring.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

Thank you for your time and cooperation regarding case
0467951.
We have been working on your request, but in order to proceed further we require additional input from your side. As we did not receive the requested information, we are unable to continue the investigation and will now close this case.
The answer to the issue is that we saw that the connection was lost between the car and the charger at that specific moment. This had to do with a network error.
We kept an eye on the charger for the last 3 days, and we didn`t see any errors appearing in the charger, and the charger looks healthy
